## Profile

### **Mondoli**

What started as “The Mondoli’s Blood” coffee shop in west Chengdu, tranformed into a popular coffee shop/ cocktail bar located at Tangbajie in 2018.

It’s donned in a heavy dose of dark woods and black, furnished with bugs and skulls and taxidermist foxes and such. Those aside, the coffee and cocktails are excellent as well.

**Opening Hours**

Monday-Friday:  Coffee (13:00-19:00) / Bar (20:00-02:00)

Saturday: 20:00-02.00

Closed on Sundays

**Where**

No. 8-10 Tianxianqiao South Road, Tangbajie, Jinjiang District

锦江区镗钯街天仙桥南路8号附10号
